# Vendored AI-Infra-Guard

This directory contains the Tencent Zhuque Lab AI-Infra-Guard source used by
the TRU harness tests.

- Source commit: `036c39bd03b39ce4a811f7f125bc3b8f47e39b7c`
- Source repository: https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard
- Imported on 11 September 2026

The `.git` directory and project PDF files are omitted from this copy.
The source, Agent Scan module, PromptSecurity module, datasets, and test assets
are included.

Keep the AIG source separate from harness reports and temporary workspaces.
Do not store model API keys in this directory.
